style.backgroundSystem: clean white studio #FFFFFF alternating with warm greige panels #F4EFE8 and warm wood-terrace lifestyle scenes
style.iconSystem: thin-line minimal icons in #1C1C1C with #C9A86A accents
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio key from front-left with fill and soft contact shadow for product shots; warm natural daylight 5200-5500K for lifestyle shots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent elegant feminine footwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, near-black text and blocks #1C1C1C, warm greige secondary #D8CFC5, and rose-gold metallic accent #C9A86A; warm tone; modern elegant sans-serif headline copy in #1C1C1C only; consistent rounded rectangular and circular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; consistent scale; product never clipped; lifestyle crops keep the face out of frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone and pale wood surfaces for stills; outdoor wood decking for scenes
style.typography: modern elegant sans-serif, headlines in #1C1C1C, no serif or script mixing
